name: Jacobi Iterative Method for Diffusion
definition: An iterative solver using the Jacobi method to compute diffusion radiance L0d, its derivative ∂πL0d, first-order term L1d, and its derivative ∂πL1d by solving the discrete diffusion equation and differential diffusion equation.
summary: The Jacobi Iterative Method for Diffusion solves the discrete diffusion equation to compute radiance fields using a grid-based iterative solver, distinguishing itself from sibling methods by operating on a grid rather than discrete angular directions.
